faq_heading: Homes near Grandview Heights Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Grandview Heights Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Grandview Heights Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Grandview Heights Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Grandview Heights Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Pacific Heights Elementary (0.3 km north-east), Edgewood Elementary (0.8 km south-west) and Southridge School (2.0 km west).

Grandview Heights Secondary is a secondary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 16987 25 Ave. It teaches grades 8 to 12.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Grandview Heights Secondary.
How the Grandview Heights Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Grandview Heights Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. Ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Grandview Heights Secondary

6 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Grandview Heights Secondary in a straight line (5 elementary, 1 other; 1 independent). The closest is Pacific Heights Elementary, 0.3 km away, and the farthest on this list is South Meridian Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest independent school is Southridge School (2.0 km).
